title: Exchange Terms Across Return Types
content:
Of the six Returns & Exchanges return types, two replace the returned units: the Size Exchange and the Instant Exchange. This table gives the exchange terms of every type; on the four types that do not exchange, each term is either not applicable or zero.

| Return type | Replacement ships | Replacements allowed | If the replacement is out of stock at shipping | Exchanges per original line | Shipping fee for the replacement (USD) | Highest replacement value on an Instant Exchange (USD) | Original order must be paid at least partly by card or wallet | Card hold covers | Card hold is charged when |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Return | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | No | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Store Credit Return | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | No | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Size Exchange | After inspection | Same style, same price | Refund to the original tenders | 1 | 0.00 | 0.00 | No | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Instant Exchange | Immediately | Same style, same price | Not applicable | 1 | 0.00 | 400.00 | Yes | Replacement price plus tax | The return expires, is cancelled or is rejected |
| Gift Return | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | No | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Quality Issue Return | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | No | Not applicable | Not applicable |

## Differences between the two exchanges

| Point | Size Exchange | Instant Exchange |
|---|---|---|
| When the replacement ships | After inspection | Immediately |
| Out-of-stock setting | Refund to the original tenders | Not applicable |
| Value limit on the replacement | None (0.00 setting) | 400.00 USD |
| Card or wallet tender required on the original order | No | Yes |
| Card hold | None | Replacement price plus tax |

Example (hypothetical): a replacement with a retail value of 400.00 USD is within the Instant Exchange limit; one valued at 400.01 USD is not.
